description.subtitle: Celta Vigo 2026 2027 Hummel track jacket - beige
description.tagline: El estilo del Celta dentro y fuera del campo
description.intro: The Hummel Celta jacket from Vigo Travel is part of the official RC Celta walking collection for the 2026-2027 season. Designed to accompany the team on their travels, it combines elegant style with the comfort and functionality necessary for everyday life.
key_benefits: Official RC Celta design: Jacket from the Travel collection for the 2026 2027 season.
Light protection: Its light fabric offers comfort and protection from the wind.
Comfortable fit: High neck, elastic cuffs and waist.
Detalles exclusivos: Escudo oficial del RC Celta y acabados deportivos.
